tour.keyboard: Esc closes the guide · Tab navigates · arrow keys within the guide change the step
tour.empty: This terrarium has no living ants. Close the guide and reopen it when an inhabitant is available. Your experiment will not be restarted.
tour.step.0.title: One inhabitant, another point of view
tour.step.0.description: This guide takes you into an ant’s view in three steps. Use a mouse or keyboard, skip it and reopen it whenever you like. The terrarium keeps its current state.
tour.step.1.title: 1. Choose an inhabitant
tour.step.1.description: The list below the terrarium shows living ants. Choose one or use the current selection. With a keyboard, Tab reaches the list and arrow keys change the selection.
tour.step.2.title: 2. Enter first-person view
tour.step.2.description: Activate “First person ↗” beside the list. You can also double-click an ant in the scene. The guide advances when the camera actually enters.
tour.step.3.title: 3. See where she walks
tour.step.3.description: You have entered an ant’s perspective. Drag in the scene to look around. Finish the guide and use “Leave ant view” or Esc to return. This is an exploratory model, without species calibration.
